svg.title: Left and right rates of motion cells, descending neurons and the brain's neck motor neurons under a drum rotating each way and stripes moving down and up
svg.text: Wide-field motion reaches the brain's neck motor neurons: yaw ones strongly, the pitch ones weakly
Rung 6's whole brain with its eyes, open loop (8 flies). A drum drives the yaw neck motor neurons on the side whose HS cells it excites;
stripes moving down drive the VS cells and DNp20 hard and CvN7 a little, the right way round. Filled: left cells; open: right.
